description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian stock's return compared with an index such as Nifty 50 over a period.

One stock's return beside an NSE index's over the same window.

    `symbol` is an NSE equity symbol, `index` an NSE index name (default "Nifty 50"). Window: `days`
    (default 365, max 1825) or `from_date`/`to_date`. Returns each side's return %, annualised volatility,
    max drawdown, best and worst day, and `difference_pct` (stock minus index, percentage points). The
    stock's return compounds NSE's own close/prev_close, so splits and bonuses do not break it. Price
    returns, no dividends. Arithmetic only.

index.description: NSE index name, e.g. "Nifty 50", "Nifty Bank" or "Nifty IT" (not a slug).
index.title: Index

name: get_stock_vs_index
title: Stock against an index
